$comment: The public-surface gate's axes for @cosyte/x12, read by the shared gate in @cosyte/script-utils (`pnpm check:no-internal-refs`). X12 is both the standard and our own item prefix, so it is a project prefix here and no X12 designation is listed: the sibling repos' X12-\d{3} exclusion matched 141 of our identifiers and no standards designation (#120). The umbrella-item-id rule is the bare `S` and four digits then a hyphen that x12's docs-content test used to assert; the canonical identifier rule needs a lower-case slug after the hyphen, so this keeps the wider form, on every surface the gate reads. The umbrella-decision-id rule catches a decision or work-item number of two or three digits, which the canonical set has no rule for; one digit is left out because D8, D9, D6 and D0 are X12 qualifier and code values. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .changeset/README.md are surfaces because this repository is public.

extraRules.name: umbrella work-item identifier
negatives: HCPCS S9083 and S0630 are billing codes, and S0228 alone is one too
ICD-10-CM P00-P96, NM1-03 name, SV1-02 charge, 835 remittance, segment S, 2000-2300 loops

extraRules.name: umbrella decision or work-item number
positives: the operator's rule (D56 in the umbrella's decisions)
negatives: DTP-02 is D8 for a date and RD8 for a range, REF-01 D9 is a claim number
toISO({ formatQualifier: "D6" }), status category D0, HCPCS D0120 is a dental code
